hardware_variant: E14/E25 baseline interfaces; P01 is a separate unimplemented candidate

hard_holds.source_redesign_not_implemented: P01 requires new schematic/layout and renewed qualification
hard_holds.downstream_distribution_open: P01 DC budget ends at E25 output star; outgoing contacts/fanouts remain open
hard_holds.large_capacitance_stability_open: TPS62903 direct50uF recommendation versus connected5.88mF requires a new loop/inrush study
hard_holds.peripheral_and_fanout_assemblies_open: 24 required peripheral/anode pins and unselected fanouts
hard_holds.remaining_boards_open: Converter, analog/monitor/bypass and peripheral assemblies are not a qualified routed full-unit design

cases.title: Isolated E23 protected input under approved source/load conditions
cases.prerequisite: Independent source-bound fixture and isolated-board release
cases.procedure: Review polarity, input ratings, selected fuse/source and bounded fault fixture first. Test E23 alone into a dummy load. Record actual input/output/current; these bounds are E14's downstream normal-input allocation, not proof of E23 current-limit/SOA protection.

cases.title: P19 signed DC at source
cases.prerequisite: Independent source-bound fixture and isolated-board release
cases.procedure: Use the selected hardware variant and local reference return. Sweep the three load conditions up to the E17 allocation 0.026 A. Source limits are a necessary design-target screen; protected-star measurements do not qualify outgoing load-harness voltage. Record shared-return/cross-domain loading and temperature. Negative rails are signed, never absolute-valued.

cases.title: Input interruption/reversal/current-limit and fault energy
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Inject only a separately reviewed, current/energy-limited fixture. Capture input, eFuse output/current and relevant temperatures. Programming-error allocations are not an established protection envelope.

cases.title: Six-rail ripple and load-step response
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Capture every source/protected rail and return movement with probe bandwidth/connection documented. The digital 10 mV excursion is an E17 allocation; analog dynamic and settling limits remain unqualified.

cases.title: All-rail start, ramp, shutdown and quick replug
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Capture input/current, six source and protected rails, reference, gates, ready/permit and relay contacts. Repeat across an approved ramp/temperature matrix. An energy-derived minimum time is not a startup upper bound.

cases.title: Close E25 onto discharged protected bulk after the source is running
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Use a reviewed dummy-load fixture and selected capacitor/ESR inventory. A source soft-start does not limit a later disconnect closure. P01's direct-output capacitance recommendation does not validate the connected millifarad network.

cases.title: Rail/reference/logic brownout and fresh rearm
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Remove one domain at a time using an approved isolation fixture; hold MCU permit high through the event. Observe gates, latch, coil current, actual contact continuity and audio. Do not infer contact state from latch Q.

cases.title: P19 loaded overvoltage/interruption behavior
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Record source threshold, protected voltage, all gate-source voltages and fault current with the reviewed energy-limited fixture. The old 125 us interruption term is an unproved allocation, not a guaranteed full-device or fault-to-dry limit.

cases.title: N19 loaded overvoltage/interruption behavior
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Record source threshold, protected voltage, all gate-source voltages and fault current with the reviewed energy-limited fixture. The old 125 us interruption term is an unproved allocation, not a guaranteed full-device or fault-to-dry limit.

cases.title: Opposing MOSFET banks, leakage and power-domain transitions
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Observe every gate relative to its own common-source node, including the two parallel digital devices on each side. Measure current sharing and residual conduction. Datasheet timing at a different gate load is not an acceptance limit here.

cases.title: Manual contacts, gain change and independent relay qualification
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Measure actual wet/dry and input contact continuity independently of latch Q. Exercise manual bypass and mode contacts; capture coil/TVS, gain request, readiness, permit and audio. E11 contains K1/K2; its optional J4 must not add duplicate coils.

cases.title: Real audio and foreground stalls, frozen heartbeat and permit
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Use a source-hashed fault-injection firmware image; stop each execution path independently. Pulling a GPIO manually is not a processor-stall test. Record real contacts and remaining signal behavior across watchdog phases.

cases.title: All controls, touch/angle sensors and bus failure behavior
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Walk the 320-pair logical map against purchased terminal assignments. Exercise every contact, selector endpoint, pot, touch region and full release stroke; disconnect each bus/sensor and verify fault policy. Physical switch pin numbering is not established by logical labels.

cases.title: All 96 sinks, emitter anodes and partial-power/latch behavior
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Use the selected 2.54-to-1.27 mm adapter and reviewed common-anode assignments. Verify scan order, brightness/current, blank/latch edges and restore behavior. Schematic sink channels do not complete a physical emitter board.

cases.title: Real-card startup, malformed files, removal and fallback
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Capture J12 power/inrush, SD lines, file-result diagnostics, heartbeat/converter/permit and elapsed time. The software checks an 8 s inter-operation budget; blocking SDK calls may exceed it. Do not use 8 s as a hard test limit or qualify current from a host file test.

cases.title: SDMMC DMA/cache and SRAM behavior on the real MCU
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Bind captures to the actual ELF and selected SDK; inspect AXI DMA addresses/cache maintenance, guard data and checksums across repeated/error reads. ELF addresses alone do not demonstrate live DMA/cache correctness.

cases.title: Physical callback deadline and no filesystem/allocation in audio
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Use calibrated timing capture and source-hashed instrumentation around the real 48 kHz/128-frame callback. Include interrupt/control load. The firmware trips above 2400 us; passing this test does not establish end-to-end latency.

cases.title: Full stereo gain calibration and mode transitions
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Calibrate the complete analog chain, not an isolated software gain. Record source/output level conventions, load, trims, neutral DSP and bypass comparisons. Approved trim range/gain-error and transition limits are still needed.

cases.title: Noise/distortion/frequency response against declared project targets
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Record 20 Hz-20 kHz sweep, noise, distortion, residual source/analyzer floor, weighting, bandwidth, reference level and load. Master SNR target is98 dB; Send/Return target is102 dB (a case-specific check enforces it). Frequency-response tolerance and the final comparison method remain unqualified; do not substitute THD+N for a THD target silently.

cases.title: Analog headroom and interface loading
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Use a reviewed overload/protection fixture and declared clipping criterion. Record reference level, frequency and10k output load. These are project interface targets; raw ADC full-scale/bias stability still needs independent qualification.

cases.title: Stereo round-trip latency, crosstalk and effects fidelity
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Capture dry and processed stereo impulses/sweeps at declared gain/control positions, including converter and bypass latency. Reference matching and acceptable latency/crosstalk tolerances are not established by host tests.

cases.title: Enclosed full-load thermal behavior and regulator stability
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Record ambient, case/component hotspots, estimated junction temperatures and actual stackup/airflow. For baseline digital-source accuracy the0..85 C junction allocation matters; P01 has a different source and needs its own thermal review. Do not treat an absolute maximum or the CAD vent gap as a thermal qualification.

cases.title: Conducted/radiated emissions and audio coupling characterization
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: Document probe/antenna/coupler geometry, bandwidth, detector and environment. Applicable standard, limits and compliance setup have not been selected; this is characterization, not an EMI-compliance pass.

cases.title: Two-hour powered standalone audio/control session
cases.prerequisite: Completed/reviewed system design and staged assembly release
cases.procedure: After the earlier stages pass, exercise effects/controls and completed storage behavior in the actual enclosure. Retain continuous recordings/logs and warm repeat-fault captures. This standalone test does not claim a rekordbox routing soak.
